title: Dimensions and coordinate conventions

pre-2002.note: The state Enrie 1931 and STURP 1978 recorded; the default.

post-2002.note: After the 2002 restoration removed the 1534 patches and the backing cloth.

axes.value: Y up; flat cloth in the XZ plane; u across the width (X), v along the length (Z)

uv.text: u_m runs 0..width across the cloth, v_m runs 0..length along it; texture s = u_m / width, t = v_m / length. Placed flat: X = u_m - width/2, Y = 0, Z = v_m - length/2, so s runs along +X and t along +Z, as an X3D ElevationGrid maps them. Seen as in the usual horizontal display (dorsal image left, frontal right, heads meeting in the middle), v_m = 0 is the left end. In the synthetic maps u_m = width is the figure's left side in both images; for a measured map, record its own orientation.

synthetic_map_grid.note: Half the convention grid; the synthetic image has no detail finer than 5 mm. Sample by UV.

png_rows: Row 0 of every map PNG is t = 1 (v_m = length); the last row is t = 0.
